faq.title: Answers before you dive in
faq.description: A short list of the questions institutions ask most often.
faq.a1: Universities, colleges, and training institutes that need LMS, exams, coding practice, and analytics in a single enterprise platform.
faq.q2: Can we roll out module by module?
faq.a2: Yes. Start with LMS or Coding Labs and expand into exams, IDE, and analytics as your teams are ready.
faq.a3: Enterprise plans are designed for SSO and role-based access across campuses, departments, and programs.
faq.q4: Is there a sandbox for evaluation?
faq.a4: Contact us at shuklamanya99@gmail.com for a guided demo environment. Starter accounts can explore core flows without a payment commitment.
faq.a5: AI features respect institution policies, with audit trails and faculty-configurable guardrails for student-facing tools.

about.title: About the platform
about.subtitle: Learnova is an enterprise AI learning platform for modern institutions — LMS, ERP, examinations, coding, cloud IDE, ideation, analytics, and audit in one coherent product.
about.believeSubtitle: Learning infrastructure should feel as refined as the products students aspire to build.
about.pillar1Body: LMS, ERP, exams, and coding labs share one identity, one academic structure, and one source of truth.
about.pillar2Body: Cloud IDE and practice labs turn coursework into production-shaped skills with measurable mastery.
about.pillar3Body: Ideation and assistance stay institution-scoped, auditable, and aligned to faculty policy.
about.pillar4Body: Analytics surface where cohorts stall so leaders can intervene with clarity, not guesswork.
about.pillar5Body: Roles, audit trails, and campus-aware governance come standard — not bolted on later.
about.pillar6Body: A premium experience for students and operators alike, across light and dark themes.
about.finalTitle: Built for institutions that teach at scale
about.finalDescription: From program structure to exam integrity and coding mastery, Learnova gives campuses a single operating system for academic delivery — without sacrificing polish or control.
